The requirements are:
[VCMSP03-2] (functional) If Speciality does not exist with Speciality Id, an exception error message will be displayed “Speciality does not exist”
[VCMDR01] (functional) Administrators Menu Screen to Maintain Doctors a) Add Doctors b) Edit/Update Doctors
[VCMDR02] (functional) Add Doctor Screen - Doctor Id(generated), Doctor Name, Age, Sex, Qualification & Experience
[VCMDR03-1] (functional) Edit/ Update Doctors Screen - Query on Doctor Id, Doctor Name, Age, Sex, Experience and Qualification will be displayed and can be modified or deleted.
[VCMDR03-2] (functional) If Doctor does not exist with Doctor Id, an exception error message will be displayed “Doctor does not exist”
[VCMDR03-3] (functional) For Deleting Doctor Details a check will be made from Patient Consultation Request to ensure that there are no open requests - if so, an exception error message will be displayed “Doctor has open Consultation Requests - cannot delete”
[VCMCL01] (functional) Administrators Menu Screen to Maintain Chemist & Labs a) Add Chemist / Labs b) Edit/Update Chemist/ Labs
[VCMCL02] (functional) Add Chemist/ Lab Screen - Chemist/Lab Id (generated), Chemist/Lab Flag, Chemist Lab Name, Chemist Lab Address and Chemist Lab Contact Details
